journey.name: Play and Pause Episode
journey.description: Verifies that tapping Play on an episode begins playback and updates the UI, and tapping Pause pauses playback.

actions.action: Verify that the app is on the Home screen and episodes are visible.
Tap the "Play" button on the first episode in the list.
Verify that the mini-player bar appears at the bottom of the screen showing the playing episode title.
Verify that the mini-player play button displays a "Pause" icon.
Tap the "Pause" button on the mini-player bar.
Verify that the episode is paused and the mini-player button displays a "Play" icon.
